acceptanceCriteria: A live corvint-test-runner run selecting a swift-testing suite (Module.Suite) executes that suite's tests (not NO_TESTS) and excludes others; raw report, receipt and version tuple retained.
The TRE platform qualification matrix cites the witness.
body: Found by the V1-0594 platform runner lane (beamfall/corvint#1000, head 111cfbebc, 2026-10-17; macOS 26.6.2 arm64, Swift 6.4, Xcode 27.0). PR #1000 fixed the swift-testing --filter anchor from ^name$ to ^name(/|$) because SwiftPM 6.4 matches against the full test ID (Module.name()/File.swift:l:c). Live witnesses exist for function-level selection only; a suite-level selector (Module.Suite) is covered only by TestSwiftTestingSelectorMatchesSourceSuffixedID. Expected: a retained live run selecting a suite through corvint-test-runner plan/run, proving it executes the suite's tests and not zero.
title: swift-testing suite-level selector (Module.Suite) has no live runner witness; the ^name(/|$) anchor (TRE-V0-075) is unit-tested only
